description: This file defines a Parser class for processing Webservice queries related to vtiger CRM, specifically parsing VTQL query language inputs to generate SQL and extract object metadata.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing VTQL queries, producing SQL statements, and retrieving object metadata or errors.

methods.name: Parser.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser with user and query input.

methods.name: Parser.parse
methods.description: Performs the parsing process of the VTQL query, updating internal state regarding success or failure.

methods.name: Parser.getSql
methods.description: Returns the generated SQL query after parsing.

methods.name: Parser.getObjectMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the object involved in the query.

methods.name: Parser.getError
methods.description: Returns the error message if parsing failed.
